errors.text_span: originate from the top axis line at -22
errors.evidence: This incorrectly describes how the bars are drawn. The bars are hanging bars where the bottom endpoint indicates the value on the y-axis. They do not originate from the -22 line. If they did, a bar representing -23 would have a length proportional to 1 unit, and a bar representing -26 would have a length proportional to 4 units (a 4x difference). Visually, the difference in bar lengths does not match this ratio, indicating the statement about their origin is incorrect.
